pr_title: sd-dhcp6-client: ignore unavailability of IA_NA or IA_PD in status code
pr_body:
If the client gets neither IA_NA nor IA_PD option, then it is already
correctly handled at the end of client_parse_message(). So, it is not
necessary to refuse the message here.

Moreover, the commits 01b4e90f32c72900f26f8f770cfb0e6d66c14706 and
483566e5ba9e4214e04106ae8760a79a13d710c2, the client always requests
both IA_NA and IA_PD unconditionally. So, it is natural that some
servers reply with the status codes of unavailability of address or
prefix, and the client needs to handle such status codes gracefully.

Fixes #22068.

issue_context.title: systemd-networkd: PD doesn't work in some case
issue_context.body:
Hello. The prefix delegation feature is broken for me since 250v.

The configuration, that works in 249v:
`10-wan.network`:
```
[Match]
Name=wan

[Network]
IgnoreCarrierLoss=true
KeepConfiguration=dhcp-on-stop
DHCP=yes
IPForward=yes
IPv6AcceptRA=true
IPv6LinkLocalAddressGenerationMode=random
IPv6Token=prefixstable
DNS=2dc0:a17b:7415:0000:021b:21ff:fe63:2216

[DHCPv4]
UseDNS=false

[DHCPv6]
ForceDHCPv6PDOtherInformation=true
WithoutRA=information-request
UseDNS=false

[IPv6AcceptRA]
UseDNS=false
```
`11-lan.network`:
```
[Match]
Name=lan

[Network]
IgnoreCarrierLoss=true
KeepConfiguration=dhcp-on-stop
IPForward=yes
IPv6SendRA=false
DHCPv6PrefixDelegation=true

DNS=2dc0:a17b:7415:0000:021b:21ff:fe63:2216

[Address]

[Neighbor]
Address=192.168.153.254
LinkLayerAddress=ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff

[IPv6SendRA]
RouterLifetimeSec=2592000
DNS=2dc0:a17b:7415:0:21b:21ff:fe63:2216
Domains=lan.rnet.ru
DNSLifetimeSec=7776000

[IPv6Prefix]
Prefix=2dc0:a17b:7415:0000::/64
PreferredLifetimeSec=2592000
ValidLifetimeSec=7776000
Assign=false

[DHCPPrefixDelegation]
UplinkInterface=wan
```
The configuration, that must work in 250v in my opinion:

[Network]

My ISP provides me SLAAC through NDP and uses a DHCP-server for only prefix delegation and providing other configuration information (DNS servers, DNS search list).

I dumped DHCP request messages of the both versions of systemd and compared them.

249v sends a solicit message with the `IA_PD` option and without the `IA_NA` option, and the DHCP server responds an advertise message with a prefix. 250v sends a solicit message with the both options: `IA_PD` and `IA_NA`, and the DHCP server responds an advertise message with the status code `NoAddrsAvail`, because the DHCP server doesn't provide adresses.

review_comments:
Hm, will the PR result only in display of the other log message:

`return log_dhcp6_client_errno(client, SYNTHETIC_ERRNO(EINVAL), "No IA_PD prefix or IA_NA address received. Ignoring.");`

at the string 1323/1332, because the client sends still a solicit message with the both `IA_NA` and `IA_PD` option and a server will respond always `NoAddrsAvail` to it?

The line should not be triggered if at least one prefix (or address) is provided. But, the message sent by your server does not include other information like DNS servers if a non-zero status code is included. I will also address that.
